title: Create More
description: This modpack adds create and many adding along side it. no bloat, no extra mods, just create addons!
body:
Welcome to Create More, a modpack for people who love the Create mod but hate the lag that often comes with big modpacks. I made this specific modpack to offer players an amazing Create mod experience without the data bloat that comes with too many mods. There are no useless mods in this pack. Every last mod included was chosen with the best Create addons in mind for players who want to expand their gameplay without the added loading times and stuttering.

What’s inside?

The Full Create Experience with some amazing addons curated for players.
Clean and lightweight mods with no fillers.
Visual upgrades to make your factory the best it can be!

Why play this pack?

Because it's not about the mods, it's about the experience. Most modpacks have chosen to include every last mod under the sun to provide more content for the player. I've taken the opposite approach and made a more focused, smooth experience for the player who loves to build the best possible mechanics. Whether constructing a massive railway or an automated factory, Create More will allow you to build it big without the frustration of a choppy game! So jump in and start creating your dream factory!
